notes.text: Rules, both witnesses, all 30 supplied difference rows, C doubt sheet and current notation table read. Whole once, halves once each; remaining decisions used saved crops. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation.
The two numbered parts assert opposite set inclusions F\G⊂F′\G′ and F′\G′⊂F\G. This is a source claim, not a checked theorem.
Je dis claims equality of the two A-strata for F and F′, citing a lemma below and inserting that F′≪F would suffice. No missing lemma has been imported.
The parenthesis after A′=A has d’où A∈F with clear unprimed A. Retained despite H’s A′ and the surrounding proof’s subject.
The b⇒c proof is abandoned under oblique strokes and restarts b⇔c below. Exact cancellation of its final Prouvons sentence is visually open.
The bottom parenthesis opened before parties is not closed by an additional outer parenthesis before the final period; source imbalance retained.
No explicit author question was confidently identified on this page. The cf lemme plus bas reference is a forward reference, not a verification supplied by this reader.
Whether the claimed stratum equality follows under the written comparison remains unchecked. Any later mathematical test should be logged as such and must not alter clear ink.
The bottom index definitions and relation b⇔c continue beyond the visible final On a; no continuation or missing close has been supplied.
H’s prose descriptions of the margin and cancelled insertion are not source text. Their observed physical content is represented by margin/TikZ and insertion/deletion macros.
